title: Lesson 25. Meet Scratch
description: Stage, sprite, blocks and the first program: the cat walks and says "Hello!"

questions.prompt: Match the Scratch part with what it is
What happens if you swap the blocks?
options: The cat does it in another order
questions.explain: A program is commands in order.

questions.prompt: The cat ran off the stage edge. What now?
options: Drag it back with the mouse
Wait for it to come back
questions.explain: You can move a sprite with the mouse.

questions.prompt: Blocks must snap under each other with a "click".
questions.explain: Otherwise the program won't join up.

learn.intro: In Scratch, commands are coloured blocks like construction pieces. The main hero is a cat!

slides.text: The **stage** (top right) is the theatre where the hero performs. The **sprite** (the cat) is the actor. **Blocks** (left) are commands of different colours. The middle is the program area.
Blue blocks — motion, purple — looks, yellow — events. The **green flag** is the "Go!" button.
Drag blocks to the middle and snap them under each other — you should hear a "click".
slides.code:
when green flag clicked
move 10 steps
say "Hello!" for 2 seconds

slides.text: Click the green flag — the cat moves and talks! You wrote your first program: the computer followed the commands in order.

check.prompt: A Scratch program starts with the green flag.

slides.text: Change it: 10 steps → 100 steps; "Hello!" → your name; add "turn 15 degrees" and the "meow" sound.
Did the cat run off the edge? Drag it back onto the stage. Save: File → Save to your computer → the Games folder → "First program".
